What we do

Paving that stays put

Most paving problems come from what's underneath, not the pavers. On Macarthur's reactive clay, a proper base with the right compaction and drainage falls is the difference between paving that lasts and paving that lifts.

We prep the base right, set the falls so water runs away from the house, and lay and seal to a clean finish — whether it's a small courtyard or a full driveway. Fixed price, no call-out fee.

  • Base excavation and preparation
  • Correct compaction for clay ground
  • Drainage falls set away from the house
  • Pavers laid, cut and jointed
  • Sealing for a clean, lasting finish
  • Site left tidy

props.label: Paving FAQs
props.html:
Good to know

Paving FAQs

What is the difference between hard and soft landscaping?
Hard landscaping is the built structure: paving, retaining walls, driveways and edging. Soft landscaping is the living side: turf, garden beds, plants and mulch. Most yards need both, planned together, so levels and drainage suit the planting. We do both in-house.
What is the best time of year to landscape in NSW?
Autumn and spring are ideal, with mild temperatures that help turf and plants establish before summer heat or winter frost. That said, we landscape year round here, and hard landscaping like paving and walls can be built in any season.
Do you charge a call-out fee?
No. Coming out to look at your job and quote it is free, every time. You only pay once you accept a fixed-price quote and we get to work. We will also beat any written quote you already have, conditions apply.
